$comment: Which cells may be charted across technologies, and why.
The method is causl-bench's runners/_contract/EQUIVALENCE.md, applied to this repo's evidence.
There is no default status. A scenario nobody has classified fails the gate, because silence
is exactly how unchecked cells stay unchecked.
toleranceNote: The bound on the ratio between the largest and smallest work count any technology reports for
one cell. Above it, comparable is refused: a wall-clock ordering across a declared asymmetry
of R is mostly a restatement of R. Measured today every comparable cell sits at 1.000, so this
bound is headroom rather than a fit to the data.

note: libvips against the three libviprs engines. Every run reports the tile and level counts, so
work equivalence is measured rather than asserted, and the libviprs engines report PSNR
against the libvips output. The reference technology carries no PSNR against itself.

reason: The harness records no equivalence_psnr_db at this size, for any engine, so the output
equivalence was never established. Work equivalence is fine (13 tiles, 10 levels, ratio
1.000); it is only the output check that did not run. Tracked as libviprs-bench#108.
Delete this override once the measurement exists.
As 512x512_c0: no equivalence_psnr_db at this size. Tracked as libviprs-bench#108.
A PMTiles archive is one file and a directory tree is many, so artefact_digest differs by
construction and output_bytes differs by container overhead. The digest is a per-backend
reproducibility check and is deliberately NOT read as cross-backend equivalence.
tiles_produced matches exactly at every scale, which is the work claim being made.

reason: pmtiles only. A directory tree has no root directory to decode, so there is no second
measurement and nothing to compare against. Measured and published on its own.
The two backends report under different ids: directory emits requests_declared and
request_bytes_declared, pmtiles emits requests and request_bytes. One is a prediction and
the other a measurement, and charting them against each other under one scenario name
compares a declaration to an observation. Measured 94 declared against 96 observed.
